question: Which former Prime Minister of India has been conferred Lifetime Achievement Honour in UK?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Manmohan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. Manmohan Singh served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014, making him one of the longest-serving PMs in Indian history.
 
• He was conferred the Lifetime Achievement Honour in the UK in recognition of his contributions to economic reforms and development in India.
 
• Dr. Singh is known for his pivotal role in liberalizing the Indian economy in 1991 when he was the Finance Minister.
 
• He is an esteemed economist and has held various significant positions including Governor of the Reserve Bank of India and Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lifetime Achievement Honour**

 
 
• This is an award given to individuals who have made significant, lasting contributions in their field over a substantial period of time.
 
• It is a mark of recognition for one's dedication, hard work, and impactful achievements.
 
• Recipients of such honors are usually veterans in their respective domains and have left a legacy that continues to inspire future generations.
 
 
 
• **Economic Reforms in India**
 
 
• In 1991, India faced a severe economic crisis. Dr. Manmohan Singh, as the Finance Minister, introduced a series of economic reforms to liberalize the economy.
 
• These reforms included reducing import tariffs, deregulating markets, and reducing taxes to attract foreign investment.
 
• The reforms are credited with transforming India's economy, leading to rapid economic growth and development.
 
 
 
• **Roles Held by Dr. Manmohan Singh**
 
 
• Dr. Singh has held numerous significant positions including Chief Economic Advisor, Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, and Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission.
 
• He was also a member of the Rajya Sabha for several terms.
 
• As the Prime Minister, he led several key initiatives and policies to boost India's economic and social development.
